wikipediaRead.title: Kingdom of Judah
wikipediaRead.locator: Lead and geography/history describe ancient polity and changing territorial extent; no fixed modern-border polygon.
wikipediaRead.supportJa: 古代ユダ王国という政治体の解説であり、本文の地域・政治体と関連するが、現代の固定境界とは同一視できない。

primaryWitnesses.text: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: When all Israel saw that the king didn’t listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, “What portion do we have in David? We don’t have an inheritance in the son of Jesse! Every man to your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David.” So all Israel departed to their tents.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: Then King Rehoboam sent Hadoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and the children of Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rehoboam hurried to get himself up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

primaryWitnesses.text: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, one hundred eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: But the LORD’s word came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

primaryWitnesses.text: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: But the LORD’s word came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: ‘The LORD says, “You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers! Every man return to his house; for this thing is of me.”’” So they listened to the LORD’s words, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

primaryWitnesses.text: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: ‘The LORD says, “You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers! Every man return to his house; for this thing is of me.”’” So they listened to the LORD’s words, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 「cities of Judah」に住む人々の地域。族祖ユダ個人とは異なる。
「house of Judah and Benjamin」は戦士を集める共同体であり、地理用例として採用しない。
「king of Judah」は政治体称号、「in Judah and Benjamin」は地域表現として区別。
ユダに防備の町を築く用例。
